scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every later phase.

scores.evidence: "Terraform plus app-of-apps in Git; pinned runner image and action SHAs"
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is concrete in each phase, from pinned builds to digest promotion, shadow builds and restore-tested exports.
Failure handling appears in each phase: rollback, fail-closed admission, HA, autoscaling, drills, canary abort, read-only period.
The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.rationale: Deferred items each have a concrete pull-forward trigger.
